scope: New offline cross-system diagnostic and concrete source/cached-trace qualification. Not new task-harm trials, independent generalization, or a new mechanism.

ranking_diagnostic.principle: Keep environment utility, native score at encoded measured futures, and native score at forecasts separate. Signed forecast-selection difference may be negative. The identity is descriptive, not a mediation estimator.

source_reassessment.proposal: Initialize the unchanged native root762 planner with the real prior L6 action/observation prefix, using its default40-depth/30-second budget.
new_source_facts: Allowed historical initialization is model-belief assimilation; the recorded after-frame was used for evaluation, not an observation update of hidden globals.
The default L6 action enumerator omits the button (51,26) that consumes the identified hidden-cycle state. Its two click coordinates are no-ops at the fixed root.
Fresh40/30 already exhausted174 transitions in0.42 seconds. Previously primed depth4/3s searches also found no plan; primed40/30 remains unexecuted.
Correct hypothetical-branch state ownership would require memory in queue nodes and the deduplication key. This is more than restoring globals around the existing planner.
source_reassessment.limits: Does not prove no primed planner can work. No new run is justified for this unchanged mechanism/root, and adding actions or changing state semantics is a new system.

source_reassessment.question: Can existing caches support the same fixed-candidate truth-score diagnostic without new inference or physical replay?
facts: The512-candidate H3 ranking run saves only aggregates; per-candidate actions, true next observations, native scores and scoring RNG are absent.

Four frozen-head evaluation.pt traces contain matched initial observations and actual actions/observations/rewards, but their500-step returns follow different later policies. Those returns cannot be attributed to a shared three-step action bank.
A new post-hoc prefix bank would require model forwards and an explicitly new stochastic score realization; it would not reconstruct the original native CEM ranking.
Full-update and actor-restore results use300-step truncated evaluation with full_episode=false; frozen-head control uses500-step complete episodes.

source_reassessment.question: Does reordering spatial_edges without visible_masks misbind forecast entities in the actual actor?
facts: The actor consumes spatial_edges and separately ordered conformity_scores, plus detected_human_num; it does not consume visible_masks or aggressiveness_factor.
GST histories preserve entity IDs, spatial_edges are sorted after prediction, and talk2Env separately sorts human objects by true center distance.
A narrower visible-versus-all-entity order mismatch must be checked in the cached actual trace; it is not a consequence of pure physical entity relabeling.

go_no_go.go: Retain the local Cosmos actual-utility loss and input-channel causal evidence, DINO measured proxy mismatch, and qualified historical real outcomes. Use the common audit to avoid mixing different causal explanations.
go_no_go.no_go: No new qualified general security mechanism, deployable Bus-Cut recovery, matched Control-Cut defense or independent generalization. Do not restart the closed old panels or request an exclusive GPU on this evidence.
go_no_go.next_experiment_requirement: A distinct native writable interface, useful Clean, an observable prediction-to-decision path, and a fixed intervention with independently measured utility. Do not turn source-only candidates into negative task experiments.
